kind: correction sidecar — disclosures appended WITHOUT modifying any historical receipt file
preservation: Every historical receipt in /data/ is byte-for-byte unchanged. This sidecar records the original published pins and appends disclosures; no historical JSON was edited.

disclosures.finding: Reconstructing the dev queries from passages.json (indices 0-15, the first 16 passages with a class assignment) gives Counter({2: 16}): ALL 16 dev queries are class 2 = pg2701. The four candidate labels a/b/c/d are four possible answers, not four evaluated classes. An always-c baseline scores 100.0% on this fixture. Every dev-fixture number (energy 68.75%, direct 56.25%, Qwen3 37.5%, Qwen2.5 0%, kev 12.5%) measures performance on a single-class set and cannot establish four-class capability or same-size superiority.
disclosures.independently_confirmed_by: Generalist Hermes (2026-10-09, WORK_LOGS/NEW_AI_RECEIPT9_QA_3B485CD.md) and Strata Generalist (reconstruction, 2026-10-09).
disclosures.numbers_unchanged: Raw receipt numbers are preserved verbatim; only their interpretation is scoped.

disclosures.finding: 'Best competitor on the dev fixture: 12.5% max' is corrected to 'best newly measured receipt9 competitor: 12.5% max'. Qwen3-0.6B reached 37.5% (receipt7), recorded in the same paper, and is the best measured competitor overall on the dev fixture.

receipt9's source pin (test_baseline_remaining.py, SHA-256 2953419e42037bb1013d093c26b0d8340e3aafafc1905fe2613e996ec4b1f10c) is the CURRENT source, which includes the not-cached write-path fix made AFTER the run. It is not an exact pre-run source pin. The run's own notes admit the fix post-dates the run; the receipt's own text should not be read as attesting a pre-run source snapshot.

A balanced/disjoint held-out split is preregistered and committed BEFORE any held-out run: 8 queries, 2 per class, fully disjoint from dev queries and dev pool; shot pool, per-class counts, overlap checks, majority/no-memory baselines, per-query prediction reporting, and the four-part acceptance threshold are frozen in the manifest. The run executes only the frozen protocol; the result is published verbatim whichever way it lands.

heldout_manifest.protocol: held-out split, preregistered 2026-10-09 before any run
heldout_manifest.shot_schedule: shots_for(n, q): round-robin over classes k = c % 4, taking candidate j = len(out)//4 from the class-k pool; identical to the dev source (test_baseline_remaining.py / test_l1_adaptive_beta3.py)
heldout_manifest.excerpt: 260 characters of the passage text (the actual receipt7 source behaviour; its '48-token' label misdescribed it)
heldout_manifest.prompt_format: Passage: <excerpt> -> <letter>\n ... then 'Passage: <excerpt> -> ' ; competitor letters a/b/c/d must be single tokens (asserted)

arms.energy: beta3 repaired arm, seed 101, 60 Adam steps, trained on the DEV pool (24 passages) — training set identical to the dev protocol; evaluation on the held-out queries only
arms.direct: same architecture and training, direct (non-energy) update, seed 101
arms.competitor: Qwen3-0.6B (596M, frozen, in-context shots, CPU, float32) — the best measured same-size competitor on the dev fixture (37.5% max, receipt7)

baselines.majority_pool_constant: predict the shot-pool-majority class for every held-out query
baselines.no_retrieval_energy_head: trained energy arm with the retrieval feature set to zero
baselines.no_retrieval_direct_head: trained direct arm with the retrieval feature set to zero

acceptance_threshold.A1_energy_at_8_shots: energy arm accuracy on the held-out set at 8 shots >= 0.50 (>= 4 of 8)
acceptance_threshold.A2_beats_best_competitor: energy arm at 8 shots strictly > Qwen3-0.6B at 8 shots on the same held-out queries
acceptance_threshold.A3_beats_no_memory: energy arm at 8 shots strictly > no-retrieval energy head at 8 shots
acceptance_threshold.A4_per_class_coverage: at 8 shots, at least 1 correct in EACH of the 4 classes (anti-single-class guard)
acceptance_threshold.rule: ALL four must hold to claim held-out superiority. Any failure is published as a negative result; the numbers are reported verbatim either way.
